name: ordax-studio
description: Connect ChatGPT and other compatible clients to the ORDAX Dev host through authenticated MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Use ChatGPT with your ORDAX Dev host.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to the authenticated ORDAX MCP for local projects, files, Git, processes, previews and supported adapters. ORDAX Dev is the persistent Windows host; the conversation remains in ChatGPT.
